    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    managers = [int(x) for x in input[1:]]

    depth = [-1] * n

    def find_depth(employee):
        if depth[employee] != -1:
            return depth[employee]
        if managers[employee] == -1:
            depth[employee] = 1
        else:
            depth[employee] = find_depth(managers[employee]) + 1
        return depth[employee]

    max_depth = 0
    for i in range(n):
        max_depth = max(max_depth, find_depth(i))

    print(max_depth)

if __name__ == "__main__":
